// @action: refactor Inline variable/Inline variable
// @differs: tsserver runs `await load()` twice; ours declines (an initializer with effects is inlined only into one use in the next statement)
// @file: src/main.ts
declare function load(): Promise<{ kind: string; size: number }>;
export async function f() {
  const /*|*/media = await load();
  return [media.kind, media.size];
}
